bullets_en: Heinrich Klaasen appointed Gulf Giants captain for ILT20 Season 5.
Odisha Restricts Beach Tourism, Coastal Recreation Ahead of Cyclone Akvon's landfall in AP.
'Purity of voter list': CM Yogi defends SIR after 'missing' Hindu voters claim.

SC notice to Congress, CJP and others over Delhi trader’s plea.
bullets_ur: Heinrich Klaasen ko ILT20 Season 5 ke liye Gulf Giants ka kaptaan muqarrar kar diya gaya.
AP mein Cyclone Akvon se pehle Odisha ne beach tourism aur saahili recreation par pabandi laga di.
'Voter list ki shafafiyat': Hindu votaron ke ghayab hone ke daaway par CM Yogi ne SIR ka difa kiya.
Forest Minister ne kaha Belur se hathi muntaqil kiye jayenge, doosray ilaqon par asar na hone ki yaqeen dehani.
Delhi ke tajir ki darkhwast par SC ka Congress, CJP aur doosron ko notice.
